title: Merge & Fight TD
description: Combine merge-upgrade economy with punchy wave combat—synthesize elite defenders, unlock synergy buffs, and crush towering siege bosses.
controls: Drag matching defender units together to level them up and defend your fortress against incoming waves.

zh-CN.title: 塔防合成与战斗
zh-CN.description: 策略合成与激爽塔防双融合：边合成升级强力防御单位、边指挥前线抵御 Boss 攻城，节奏紧凑超耐玩！
zh-CN.controls: 拖拽相同防御单位合成升级，合理站位抵挡每波怪潮与巨型 Boss 进攻。
